parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The article refers to structural unemployment. Explain what this means and whether it is the
same as the natural rate of unemployment.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
To keep unemployment low, one government used fiscal policy. Analyse how this policy can
affect unemployment rates.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain how the policies of high-income economies towards ‘green energy’ changed between
2015 and 2022.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Assess whether the article provides sufficient evidence to justify its conclusion that the
intervention of governments has little effect on economic outcomes.

With the help of a diagram, evaluate the use of indifference curve analysis to explain the relationship
between a change in the price of a product and the change in an individual consumer’s demand
for this product. [20]
OR
The growth of a firm using a takeover is desirable because it enables consumers to benefit from
lower prices and the firm to gain additional profits.
Evaluate this statement. [20]
Section C
Answer one question.
EITHER
A country is experiencing stagflation, when there is a high rate of inflation at the same time as a
negative output gap.
With the help of a diagram, evaluate the effectiveness of using fiscal policy to solve this problem.
OR
A free trade area gains all the benefits associated with being a member of a customs union while
avoiding all the costs associated with being a member of a customs union.
Evaluate this statement. [20]
